appDescription: An in-vehicle safety companion for reviewing driving context, reporting road events, and requesting vehicle service.

function.name: GET_DRIVING_CONTEXT
function.description: Returns consent-gated cached SDK availability and freshness only. Does not disclose private signal values, coordinates, destination, or history.

scope.description: The category of driving context to retrieve.

function.name: REPORT_ROAD_EVENT
function.description: Prepares a road event report for the user to review and explicitly confirm before submission.

kind.description: The category of road event to report.

function.name: REQUEST_SERVICE_BOOKING
function.description: Prepares a vehicle service request for the user to review and explicitly confirm before submission.

serviceType.description: The vehicle maintenance or inspection service requested.

requestedDate.description: The preferred service date in ISO 8601 format.

notes.description: Additional details for the service request.
